## AI Search Lab
- Month 0 (22 Oct 2026): AI identity test. ChatGPT was unsure, Gemini found no record, Perplexity identified him from LinkedIn.
- Experiment 1 (23 Oct 2026): "Who are the best SEO agencies in Mohali?" Four AI tools named 17 agencies; none was named by all four. Rerun on 26 Oct: 21 agencies, still none in all four.
